notes.text: Selected 20260830-R5 'Arrival at a place is an event': first arrival at each POI shows a visible, non-blocking acknowledgement; repeats stay quiet; ?dev capture hooks unaffected. Now planning: survey how arrival currently surfaces (objective ring, place label, inRegion) in src/map.js and src/main.js, then design a small first-visit acknowledgement keyed on POI id in persistent visited-state.

R5 implemented: placeAt() in map.js (placeLabel refactored onto it, so HUD name and acknowledgement can never disagree), visitedPlaces Set persisted in the save (snapshot.visited), boot place seeded so loading never announces where you already are, and a non-blocking flourish (label pulse + '· first visit' note, own lane — not the mission toast). Verification: scripts/probe-arrival.mjs 8/8 PASS (boot quiet; ranchGate first-arrival pulse+note; flourish self-expires; re-entry does not repeat; overlook still gets its own first visit; no page errors; visited set persisted through the game's own beforeunload autosave — evidence audit/evidence/probe-arrival-R5.log). npm run check PASS. Capture tooling untouched: __captureView moves only the camera, player pose stays at boot, so audit captures stay fanfare-free.
